response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.order_count) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.order_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_excess_count FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.order_count > b.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate produces no defined ratio, so that row is ignored by the ratio average but its order remains in the distinct-order count.
